# Importing data

The dataset holds one row per case.

## Import and export of files

| Format | Extension | Import package | Export package | Installed |
|--------|-----------|----------------|----------------|-----------|
| SAS | .sas7bdat | haven | haven | Yes |
| Plain text | .txt | readr | readr | Not by default |
